# Netplan

The netplan files osapi writes, validated and applied.

## Where it is served

Nowhere: it is internal. Other behaviors require it and call its methods
on the same host, so it has no route, no command and no permissions.

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| [managedfile](../managedfile/managedfile.md) | [dns](../dns/dns.md), [interface](../interface/interface.md), [route](../route/route.md) |

## Chain

The calls that each example makes, each under the call that made it. `osapi behavior chain get --name netplan` shows them, and `--json` has each in full.

### A new file (`update`)

| Call | Sends | Gets |
| ---- | ----- | ---- |
| `netplan update` | `content=<6 lines> path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` | `changed=true path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` |
| `└─ managedfile update` | `content=<6 lines> mode=0600 path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml secret=false` | `changed=true path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` |

### A file osapi wrote (`delete`)

| Call | Sends | Gets |
| ---- | ----- | ---- |
| `netplan delete` | `path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` | `changed=true path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` |
| `└─ managedfile delete` | `path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` | `changed=true path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` |

### A file that is not there (`delete`)

| Call | Sends | Gets |
| ---- | ----- | ---- |
| `netplan delete` | `path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` | `changed=false path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` |
| `└─ managedfile delete` | `path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` | `changed=false path=/etc/netplan/osapi-dns.yaml` |

## Where it runs

On `debian`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

It runs `netplan` with sudo, so the agent's user needs a sudoers entry for it
unless the agent runs as root. `osapi agent start` checks this at startup.

It runs `netplan`, which the host must have installed. `osapi agent start`
warns about any that are missing.

It writes `/etc/netplan/osapi-*.yaml`.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.netplan.<method>`, with `behavior.managedfile.<method>`, `exec netplan`, `exec chown`, `exec stat`, `file.write`, `file.remove`, `file.chmod`, `kv.get`, `kv.put` under it.

Its span records the input `path` (update, delete), `name` (get).

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ----------- |
| `update` | write | Write a netplan file, validate it and apply it |
| `delete` | write | Remove a netplan file and apply what is left |
| `get` | read | Get what netplan status reports for an interface |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.

## Inspecting it

```bash
osapi behavior get --name netplan                           # surfaces, methods, types, settings, telemetry
osapi behavior method get --name netplan --method <method>  # one method, with its JSON Schema
```
